title: Hydraulic cylinder
description: A double-acting ISO 6020-2 tie-rod cylinder, bore 40, rod 28, with clevises at both ends, a rod that moves with a parameter and a cutaway that shows the piston, the seals and the gland.
process: Turning, honing, hard chrome plating, painting

difficulty.rationale: Fourteen bodies coupled through 96 variables, a conditional cutaway through revolves, booleans and formula-count patterns, an oil solid giving closed-form chamber volumes, buckling checks and ISO 6020-2/8133 knowledge; no freeform, so not 9.

materials: Zinc-plated steel tie rods, nuts and pins
Bronze-filled PTFE guide and wear rings

prompt_test.model: Claude Sonnet 5.5, medium effort, through craft3d-cli
prompt_test.result: Passed with one gap: oil 125.810 and 64.235 cm³ (closed form), pin to pin 510 mm, forces 20.106/10.254 kN, buckling 6.73, ports 258.05 mm, all as this example's; seven checks pass at all eight corners; moving mass 1.951 kg because it counted the pin (turn 6 now names the parts); 26 bodies; about 306 steps.
